_help: Act 3, a night camp on the road (any route, before the race): talk to each companion once (camp3_<id>), grouped so the wheel never holds more than 6. Small trust / conviction changes and a few flags (heard_veil, drilled_crew, rationing). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act3.py.

start.speaker: player
start.line: Night on the road. The fire's low and the party's still awake.

c_eleanor.speaker: eleanor
c_eleanor.line: Do you think it's really out there? Not the gold. The answers.

choices.label: Say you believe it
choices.line: I know it is. And you'll be the one who reads it.

choices.label: Say it's a payday
choices.line: I think it's a payday. Answers are your department.

c_eleanor_a.speaker: eleanor
c_eleanor_a.line: Then I'd better not be wrong.

c_eleanor_b.speaker: eleanor
c_eleanor_b.line: Then I'll find them on my own.

c_pembroke.speaker: pembroke
c_pembroke.line: Forty sherds catalogued since Cairo. All Roman, all worthless, all properly labelled.

choices.label: Encourage him
choices.line: Keep at it, Doctor. When we get there, it'll matter.

choices.label: Mock him
choices.line: Nobody's going to care about your pots.

c_pembroke_b.speaker: pembroke
c_pembroke_b.line: Somebody has to care, or this is just looting.

c_hassan.speaker: hassan
c_hassan.line: Do you know why the old priests called it the Veil?

choices.label: Ask him to tell you
choices.line: Tell me.

choices.label: Save it for later
choices.line: Save the stories for when we get there.

c_hassan_a.speaker: hassan
c_hassan_a.line: Because some things are not gone. Only covered. Sleep well.

c_hargreaves.speaker: hargreaves
c_hargreaves.line: I'd like to drill the lads on the rifles each night. An hour. They'll thank me later.

choices.label: Let him drill them
choices.line: Do it.

choices.label: Let them rest
choices.line: They're exhausted, Tom. Let them sleep.

c_hargreaves_b.speaker: hargreaves
c_hargreaves_b.line: Your call. I hope you don't regret it.

c_idris.speaker: idris
c_idris.line: My sister writes. She has a place at the school now, because of your money.

choices.label: Be glad for him
choices.line: Good. That's the best thing this money will do.

choices.label: Keep him on the job
choices.line: Keep your mind on the job, Idris.

c_idris_a.speaker: idris
c_idris_a.line: You are a strange kind of employer. A good kind.

c_idris_b.speaker: idris
c_idris_b.line: My mind is always on the job. That is why I am alive.

c_isabelle.speaker: isabelle
c_isabelle.line: You keep watching me as if I'm about to ride off.

choices.label: Tell her you're glad
choices.line: I'm just glad you're here.

choices.label: Ask if she would
choices.line: Would you?

c_isabelle_b.speaker: isabelle
c_isabelle_b.line: Maybe. Keep giving me reasons not to.

c_saleh.speaker: saleh
c_saleh.line: We are drinking more water than I planned. Tomorrow, half rations.

choices.label: Agree
choices.line: Half rations. Make sure everyone knows why.

choices.label: Overrule him
choices.line: We'll manage. People need their strength.

c_saleh_a.speaker: saleh
c_saleh_a.line: Good. The desert respects a careful man.

c_youssef.speaker: youssef
c_youssef.line: Let me scout ahead tomorrow, alone. I will find us a faster way.

choices.label: Let him go
choices.line: Go. Back by noon.

choices.label: Keep him close
choices.line: You stay with the column.

c_youssef_b.speaker: youssef
c_youssef_b.line: As you say. But I would have found it.

c_farid.speaker: farid
c_farid.line: There is a trader near here who owes me. Let me do a little business on the way.

choices.label: Let him trade
choices.line: Go ahead. Just don't slow us down.

choices.label: No side deals
choices.line: No side deals, Farid. Not on my time.

c_farid_a.speaker: farid
c_farid_a.line: You will not even notice I was gone.

c_farid_b.speaker: farid
c_farid_b.line: Business never sleeps. But it can wait.

c_mahmoud.speaker: mahmoud
c_mahmoud.line: My men ask: when we dig, whose name goes on the finds?

choices.label: Theirs
choices.line: The men who dig them up.

choices.label: The expedition's
choices.line: The expedition's. That's how it works.

c_mahmoud_a.speaker: mahmoud
c_mahmoud_a.line: I will tell them. They will dig twice as carefully.

c_mahmoud_b.speaker: mahmoud
c_mahmoud_b.line: That is how it always works.

c_khalil.speaker: khalil
c_khalil.line: Two of my men are sick from the water.

choices.label: Give them your share
choices.line: Give them clean water from my ration.

choices.label: They'll toughen up
choices.line: They'll toughen up.

c_khalil_a.speaker: khalil
c_khalil_a.line: They will not forget this. Neither will I.

c_naguib.speaker: naguib
c_naguib.line: The camels are carrying too much. Lighten the loads, or we lose one by the end of the week.

choices.label: Lighten the loads
choices.line: Do it. Leave the spare crates.

choices.label: Push on
choices.line: We need everything. Push on.

c_naguib_a.speaker: naguib
c_naguib_a.line: A wise choice. The camels thank you.

choices.label: Turn in
choices.line: Get some sleep. Long day tomorrow.
